# govault_secret (Ephemeral Resource)

Read one GoVault secret without storing it in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "govault_secret" "example" {
  path = "infrastructure/example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Slash-delimited secret path.

### Optional

- `version` (Number) Optional positive secret version; omit for latest.

### Read-Only

- `resolved_version` (Number, Sensitive) Version returned by GoVault.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Ephemeral secret value.
